item.title: Construction Daily Log Book: Who was on site, what got done, and what held it up
item.description: One day to a page, numbered 001 to 096 in print. Directions, delays and inspections each have a register at the back indexed by day number, so an entry from March can be found again without paging through the book. 120 large 8.5 x 11 inch pages. The Construction Daily Log Book from Plainfield Press, a paperback on Amazon. Free sample pages to print at the link. construction daily log, daily construction report, jobsite diary, foreman log, superintendent report.
